sweeps.clubs: not club-by-club -- searched each league's confirmed 'done deals' for established attackers with top-flight Understat history whose move would otherwise land their shot rates at the wrong club
sweeps.method: web search per league; only within-league moves of players with real Understat history were actioned (cross-league arrivals have no history in the new league's feed and are invisible to props either way, so they are not overrides)
sweeps.verified_by: two independent sources or an official club announcement, per this file's standard

sweeps.not_checked: NOT an exhaustive 76-club sweep. Squad players outside each club's top attackers, defenders/midfielders (negligible props impact), and cross-league arrivals were not individually re-verified. The window is open to ~1 Sep, so this is point-in-time; the daily ESPN roster sync still governs club membership, and the matchday-news task re-checks the live board each run.

known_gaps: Promoted clubs have no Understat history, so no player markets regardless of roster verification. Not a coverage gap that verification can close.
Squad players below the top 6 by goal rate are unverified. They cannot clear a 40% goalscorer bar, so the exposure is to props display rather than to a published pick.

_verified_on_note: Date of the most recent sweep, NOT proof every override was re-checked. See _coverage for what each sweep actually covered.
